tagline: AI-Powered Digital Skills for Modern Careers
intro: Learn essential computer skills, Microsoft Office, internet usage, and modern AI tools like ChatGPT & Canva AI for jobs, study, office work, and freelancing.
overview: This course is designed for beginners who want to build practical computer skills for today’s digital and AI-powered world. Students will learn computer fundamentals, MS Office, internet & email communication, cloud tools, AI productivity tools, online safety, and basic freelancing skills to stay ready for modern careers and workplaces.

curriculum.title: Module 1: Computer Basics & Hardware - 4 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Identify computer parts
- Understand input/output devices
- Know how data is stored
- Turn on/off safely
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Label all hardware parts on a diagram
- Practise turning on/off, restart safely
- Type 30 words per minute - Bangla & English
- Identify 10 components from real device
📚 Topics Covered
- What is a computer?
- Hardware: CPU, RAM, HDD, Monitor, Keyboard, Mouse
- Input vs Output devices
- Types: Desktop, Laptop, Tablet
- Proper computer handling & care
- Typing practice: Bengali & English
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- HR staff organizes employee documents in folders
- Students keep assignments organized
- Small business tracks receipts digitally

curriculum.title: Module 2: Windows OS & File Management - 4 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Navigate Windows desktop
- Manage files and folders
- Use keyboard shortcuts
- Install/uninstall software
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Organize 20 files into proper folders
- Create a personal folder structure
- Screenshot your desktop & label all parts
- Install a free app (VLC, PDF reader)
📚 Topics Covered
- Windows 10/11 interface overview
- Desktop, Taskbar, Start Menu
- Creating folders, renaming, moving files
- Copy, Cut, Paste (Ctrl+C, V, X)
- Recycle Bin, Undo, Redo
- Installing & uninstalling apps
- Disk management basics
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- Apply for jobs via email
- Submit assignments to teachers
- Customer support via email in offices

curriculum.title: Module 3: Windows OS & File Management - 5 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Browse internet confidently
- Search effectively on Google
- end/receive professional emails
- Stay safe online
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Create a Gmail account from scratch
- Send a professional job application email
- Search 5 topics and save links
- Upload a file to Google Drive & share it
📚 Topics Covered
- What is the Internet? / ইন্টারনেট কী?
- Browser: Chrome, Firefox
- Google Search tips & tricks
- Creating a Gmail account
- Composing, Reply, Forward, CC, BCC
- Email attachments (file, photo)
- Online safety: passwords, phishing
- YouTube for learning
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- Apply for jobs via email
- Submit assignments to teachers
- Customer support via email in offices

curriculum.title: Module 4: Microsoft Word - Document Creation - 6 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Create professional documents
- Format text and pages
- Insert tables, images, headers
- Print and export to PDF
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Type and format a full CV/Resume
- Create a formal letter (চাকরির দরখাস্ত)
- Design a one-page business flyer
- Build a table-based class schedule
📚 Topics Covered
- Word interface: Ribbon, Quick Access
- Font: size, bold, italic, underline, color
- Paragraph alignment, spacing, indent
- Bullet points & numbered lists
- Tables: insert, format, merge cells
- Page layout: margins, orientation
- Headers, Footers, Page Numbers
- Save as PDF, Print document
- CV/Resume template creation
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- HR writes offer letters in Word
- Students type assignments and reports
- NGOs prepare project proposals

curriculum.title: Module 5: Microsoft Excel - Data & Spreadsheets - 7 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Enter and format data
- Use formulas for calculations
- Create charts and graphs
- Manage lists and databases
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Build a monthly household budget sheet
- Create attendance register with formulas
- Make a sales data chart for a shop
- Build a student grade calculator
📚 Topics Covered
- Excel interface: cells, rows, columns
- Data entry, AutoFill, Flash Fill
- Formulas: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MAX, MIN
- Functions: IF, VLOOKUP, CONCATENATE
- Cell formatting: borders, colors, merge
- Sorting & Filtering data
- Charts: Bar, Pie, Line chart
- Budget sheet / attendance register
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- Accounts staff tracks daily sales
- School teachers manage student marks
- Shop owners track inventory & expenses

curriculum.title: Module 6: Microsoft PowerPoint - Presentations - 5 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Create slides from scratch
- Use themes and layouts
- Add visuals, charts, transitions
- Deliver a confident presentation
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Create 10-slide company introduction deck
- Design a 5-slide product pitch
- Make a personal portfolio presentation
- Convert a Word CV into slides
📚 Topics Covered
- PowerPoint interface overview
- Slide layouts and themes
- Adding text, images, icons
- Shapes and SmartArt
- Slide transitions & animations
- Charts and tables in slides
- Presenter view & speaker notes
- Slide design principles
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- Students present projects to class
- Sales teams pitch to clients
- NGO workers present reports to donors

curriculum.title: Module 7: Introduction to AI & ChatGPT - 6 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Understand what AI is
- Use ChatGPT for everyday tasks
- Write effective prompts
- Know AI limitations & ethics
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments
- Ask ChatGPT 10 different types of questions
- Translate a paragraph with AI + compare
- Summarize a news article using AI
- Write a complaint letter using ChatGPT
📚 Topics Covered
- What is Artificial Intelligence?
- How ChatGPT works — in simple terms
- Creating a ChatGPT account (free)
- Basic prompting: asking good questions
- ChatGPT for Q&A, explanations
- Translating Bengali ↔ English with AI
- Summarizing long texts instantly
- AI dos & don'ts / ethical use
🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- Job seekers write cover letters in minutes
- Students get concepts explained simply
- Job seekers write cover letters in minutes

curriculum.title: Module 8: AI for Writing & Content Creation - 5 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Write professional documents with AI
- Create social media contento

- Build a basic content portfolio
🛠 Practical Tasks & Assignments

📚 Topics Covered

- AI image generation: Canva AI, Adobe Firefly

🌍 Real-Life Use Cases
- Businesses need daily social media content
- NGOs promote campaigns with AI graphics
- Freelancers offer content packages

curriculum.title: Module 9: AI for Productivity & Office Work - 5 Hours
curriculum.details:
🎯 Learning Objectives
- Use AI tools for office efficiency
- Automate repetitive tasks
- Create AI-powered presentations
- Manage time and tasks with AI

curriculum.title: Module 10: Freelancing, Job Skills & Final Project - 8 Hours
curriculum.details:
💻 Freelancing Platforms
- Fiverr - Gig-based, perfect for beginners
- Upwork - Hourly/fixed contracts
- Freelancer.com - Bid on projects
- LinkedIn - Professional networking & jobs
- Facebook Groups - Local BD clients
🏢 Office Job Skills
- Professional email etiquette
- Resume & CV with AI assistance
- Job portal registration (bdjobs.com)
- Interview preparation with ChatGPT
🎓 Final Project Options
- Create a personal CV using MS Word
- Build an Excel budget tracker for a shop
- Design a 10-slide presentation with AI
- Write 5 social media posts for a business
- Create a Fiverr profile for one skill
🏅 Certification Criteria
- Attend 80% of classes
- Submit final project
- Pass practical test (score 60%+)
- Complete all module assignments

reasons.title: Industry-Relevant Syllabus
reasons.text: The course teaches practical skills in highly demanded software such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access, which are highly needed in the job and freelancing market.

reasons.title: Hands-on project-based learning
reasons.text: Through 9 real-world projects, you will gain not only theory but also practical experience, which will strengthen your portfolio.

reasons.title: Expert Mentor
reasons.text: You will learn under the guidance of experienced and certified mentors, who will provide personalized feedback and career guidance.

reasons.title: Job placement and freelancing support
reasons.text: Our powerful job placement cell and freelancing marketplace guide will help you with CV creation, interview preparation, and client finding strategies.

reasons.title: Lifetime access and community support
reasons.text: Enrolling in the course will give you lifetime access and the opportunity to solve problems and network through our active community.

reasons.title: Certificates and Career Value
reasons.text: At the end of the course, you will receive an industry-ready certificate, which will help increase your professional value by adding it to your job application or freelancing profile.
